title: Chargers OC Mike McDaniel: Week 1 loss was "a case of humble pie"

sources.name: Pro Football Talk
sources.title: Chargers OC Mike McDaniel: Week 1 loss was "a case of humble pie"
sources.description: Expectations for the pairing of quarterback Justin Herbert with offensive coordinator Mike McDaniel started high and kept rising all offseason, but the Chargers' first outing of the 2026 season fell far short of them.
